subject: Lumen Health — technical alignment & implementation outline

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@lumenhealth.ai>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@lumenhealth.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Lumen Health — technical alignment & implementation outline

Thanks again for the call earlier today — appreciate the candid walk-through of the clinician workflow and current bottlenecks. Below is a short recap of what we heard, how Redwood can address it, and a proposed POC scope + next steps.

1) Primary pain points we heard
- Search + triage latency: clinicians need reranked results in the UI in under ~250ms (P95) to avoid blocking workflows.
- Embedding cost/throughput: large nightly batch re-embed and real-time query-time embeddings for triage at 50–200 qps.
- Streaming UI: the hub UI requires progressive streaming of answer text + structured suggestions (orders, links) so clinicians can act immediately.
- Integrations: function-calling / structured outputs to create orders and populate EHR fields.
- Compliance: SOC 2 / data residency constraints; some PHI concerns for production.

2) How Redwood maps to those needs (high level)
- Embeddings + rerank: we support efficient embeddings pipelines and an optimized reranker (embedding-based candidate generation + lightweight reranker) that can be served with low latency and token-cost optimizations.
- Streaming + structured outputs: SDKs (Python / JS) support streaming partial tokens and our function-calling pattern can emit strict JSON schemas that map to EHR order objects.
- Throughput and economics: Dedicated pools (reserved GPUs) with automated batching reduce per-request cost while meeting latency SLOs.
- Compliance: Private deployment (VPC / on-prem) available for production PHI; managed KMS/HSM options.

3) Proposed POC scope (4 weeks)
- Week 0: Kickoff + finalize success metrics (owner: Ben) — target P95 rerank < 250ms; inference cost target $0.03/query.
- Week 1: Ingest sample dataset + baseline embeddings (owner: Monica) — nightly re-embed +/- incremental update test.
- Week 2: Build query-time embedding + rerank pipeline; integrate streaming into clinician UI (owner: Ben + Lumen front-end).
- Week 3: Function-calling schema for order creation; run end-to-end test vectors and measure latency/cost (owner: Marissa).
- Deliverables: POC report, perf numbers, recommended config for Dedicated vs Private.

4) Immediate asks we have from you
- Example dataset extract (anonymized) for 5k records (format: CSV/JSON)
- Security/compliance contact for SOC2 checklist
- Preferred POC start week (we have capacity week of Dec 6)

Attachments: Lumen-RFI-responses.xlsx (stub), redwood-arch-diagram.png (stub)

Next steps / proposed dates:
- POC kickoff meeting: propose Tue Dec 7, 10:00am PT — 30m
- Ben to send handshake doc and Drive link once we confirm kickoff.

Thanks — happy to adjust scope if you prefer a narrower two-week trial focused on rerank + streaming first.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com

Ben — thanks for the quick summary and the clear POC plan. A few clarifications from our side after the team debrief: 

- Data residency / PHI: for any production deployment we will need to keep PHI inside our VPC in the us-west-2 region. Is that supported for both Dedicated and Private?
- Retention: what are the default token-level logs retention windows? We need an option to keep minimal logs for 90 days and then truncate.
- Throughput: when you say 50–200 qps, can you share example cluster sizing? We need an initial estimate for budget and whether this requires Dedicated GPUs or if Private on our infra is sufficient.

Also, can you confirm if function-calling enforces strict schema validation (we want guarantees that a returned JSON matches the schema to avoid malformed order objects)?

Happy to take the 30m kickoff Dec 7 but can we do 11:00am PT instead?

—Elaine
Elaine Park
Head of Product — Clinical AI
Lumen Health

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elaine Park <elaine@lumenhealth.ai>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay@lumenhealth.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Lumen Health — technical alignment & implementation outline

Elaine — great questions, and appreciate the priorities. Answers inline below.

- Data residency / PHI: yes — private deployment supports VPC-only access in us-west-2; Dedicated (Redwood-managed) can be constrained to a region with customer-controlled networking and KMS integration, but for PHI we typically recommend Private when customers need full network isolation.

- Retention: default inference logs are retained for 30 days; we support configurable retention policies up to customer-specified windows (90/180/365 days) when using Private or an Enterprise observability add-on. We can set the POC to keep minimal logs for 90 days.

- Throughput & cluster sizing (examples):
  - Small POC (baseline): 2x A10G-equivalent instances — ~50 qps sustained for simple embed+rerank with small batch sizes
  - Mid: 4x A10G / 1x H100 spot hybrid — ~200 qps with batching and KV cache for repeated contexts
  - Production Dedicated: sizing depends on tail latency SLOs and model choice — we’ll run perf tests during week 1 to finalize.

- Function-calling & schema validation: our function-calling path supports strict JSON schema enforcement at the model runtime boundary. We validate outputs against the schema and can either reject/flag mismatches or apply automatic correction heuristics depending on POC settings.

POC kickoff: Tue Dec 7 at 11:00am PT works for us — I’ll send a calendar invite.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b_Lumen-POC-Plan (POC checklist + onboarding steps)

Action items updated:
- Ben: Schedule kickoff + send pre-POC checklist (due Nov 24)
- Monica: Prepare ingest pipeline template + example scripts (due Dec 3)
- Marissa: Prepare contracting ramp and any trial pricing notes (due Nov 30)

If you want, we can also run a short lambda-based proof of concept on your infra for isolation validation before committing to Private.

Thanks,
Ben
Enterprise Solutions
Redwood Inference
